sentences.text:
11 kilometers beneath the Pacific,
lies *Challenger Deep*, Earth's deepest chasm.
sentences.spoken: Eleven kilometers beneath the surface of the Pacific Ocean lies Challenger Deep, the deepest known chasm on Earth.

sentences.text:
If *Mount Everest* sat at the bottom,
its peak would be buried under 2,000m of water.
sentences.spoken: If Mount Everest were placed at the bottom, its highest summit would still be submerged under more than two thousand meters of ocean.

sentences.text:
At this Hadal depth, water pressure
exceeds *1,080 atmospheres*.
sentences.spoken: At this Hadal depth, the water pressure exceeds one thousand and eighty atmospheres.

sentences.text:
That equals *8 metric tons of force*
crushing every square inch.
sentences.spoken: That is equivalent to eight metric tons of force crushing down on every single square inch of surface.

sentences.text:
Yet inside this crushing void,
*extraordinary life thrives*.
sentences.spoken: Yet, inside this pitch black crushing void, extraordinary life thrives.

sentences.text:
The *Mariana Snailfish* survives with
no bones, using flexible cellular armor.
sentences.spoken: The Mariana snailfish survives without scales or solid bones, using flexible cartilage and special organic cellular armor.

sentences.text:
Giant single-celled *xenophyophores*
grow to 20 cm in freezing silence.
sentences.spoken: Giant single celled xenophyophores grow to twenty centimeters wide, filter feeding on mineral sediment in absolute freezing silence.

sentences.text:
At the edge of planetary physics,
*life conquered the abyss*.
sentences.spoken: Here, at the absolute edge of planetary physics, life did not surrender to the abyss. It conquered it.
